definitions.explanation: To write something again, usually to correct errors or improve the content.

definitions.gloss: to write over again, to redo in writing
definitions.explanation: To write from scratch or revise written work.

examples.japanese: レポートを{最初|さいしょ}から{書|か}き{直|なお}さなければならない。
examples.english: I have to rewrite the report from the beginning.

examples.japanese: {間違|まちが}えたので、{書|か}き{直|なお}してください。
examples.english: You made a mistake, so please rewrite it.

examples.japanese: {作家|さっか}は{小説|しょうせつ}を{何度|なんど}も{書|か}き{直|なお}した。
examples.english: The author rewrote the novel many times.

notes:
{書|か}き{直|なお}す is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to rewrite.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {書|か}く (to write) + {直|なお}す (to redo, to fix) → to write again

ASPECT (ている):
{書|か}き{直|なお}している indicates an ongoing process of rewriting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {最初|さいしょ}から{書|か}き{直|なお}す (rewrite from the beginning)
- {何度|なんど}も{書|か}き{直|なお}す (rewrite many times)
- きれいに{書|か}き{直|なお}す (rewrite neatly)

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS WITH {直|なお}す:
- {言|い}い{直|なお}す: to say again, to correct what one said
- {作|つく}り{直|なお}す: to remake
- {考|かんが}え{直|なお}す: to reconsider
- {見直|みなお}す: to review

[Register: Neutral]
